input.quote: (a) In the event the Company terminates this Agreement, the Company shall pay to HDI a termination payment, (the "Termination Payment") the amount of which shall be an amount equal to the aggregate Net Sales for the twelve (12) months preceding the Termination Date less $800,000, the balance of which shall be divided by two.
input.rationale: Section 4.2(a) imposes a Customer-payable stipulated sum on any termination by the Company, computed as half of the excess of trailing twelve-month Net Sales over $800,000. That formula is untethered to fees and can far exceed three months of the Section 3.1 fees (30% of Net Sales above $11,000 per month), so it fails the LD fallback cap; Section 1.6 gives us only a narrow penalty-free exit if the Site launches late, and 4.2(b)-(c) merely address a zero result and quarterly instalments. We adopt the fallback rather than deleting the payment, because outright deletion would require collateral rewrites of the 4.2(b) zero-value provision, the 4.2(c) instalment mechanic and the Section 4 heading. Following the verifier's point, the 4.2(a) computation is now retained verbatim so the zero-value determination in 4.2(b) still operates and the amount remains determinable, and a new 4.2(d) caps the Termination Payment at three months' Section 3.1 fees and makes it our sole early-termination fee and sole liquidated amount. The retained 4.2(c) instalment allocation is original commercial language and remains workable against the capped amount.

proposal.summary: Retain the Section 4.2(a) computation verbatim and add a new 4.2(d) capping the Termination Payment at three months' Section 3.1 fees as the Company's sole early-termination fee and sole liquidated amount.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We left the Section 4.2(a) calculation and the 4.2(b)-(c) mechanics untouched and added a new 4.2(d) capping the Termination Payment at three months' fees and confirming it is our only early-termination fee and sole liquidated amount. Our preferred position is no Customer-payable liquidated amount, but we can accept this cap.

ops.text: The Termination Payment shall not exceed the fees payable by the Company pursuant to Section 3.1 for the three (3) months preceding the Termination Date, and shall be the Company's sole early termination fee and the sole liquidated amount payable by the Company under this Agreement.

mappings.element: Any Customer-payable liquidated amount is only an early-termination fee.
The early-termination fee is capped at three months of fees.
The early-termination fee is the sole liquidated amount payable by Customer.
